events.title: Leo Phokas ambushes and destroys a Hamdanid army at Andrassos
events.description: In a mountain pass in the Taurus Mountains, Byzantine forces under Leo Phokas the Younger ambushed and annihilated the army of Sayf al-Dawla, Hamdanid emir of Aleppo, whose raids had long troubled the empire.

events.title: Trần Thánh Tông cedes the throne to his son Nhân Tông
events.description: Trần Thánh Tông, second emperor of the Trần dynasty, ceded the throne to his son Trần Nhân Tông but shared power as retired emperor until his death in 1290. Together they were credited with the victories over the Mongol invasions.

events.title: Venice confines its glassmaking industry to Murano
events.description: A Venetian law confined most of the city's glassmaking industry to the islands of Murano, in the lagoon north of Venice. Moving the furnaces removed a fire hazard from the city and kept glassmaking expertise from potential competitors.

events.title: Cortés enters Tenochtitlan and meets Moctezuma
events.description: Hernán Cortés and his Spanish and Tlaxcalan allies were received in the Aztec capital by Moctezuma II. Within days the Spaniards took the emperor hostage, and the city fell to siege in 1521.

events.title: The Bodleian Library opens in Oxford
events.description: Sir Thomas Bodley's refounded library opened to scholars at Oxford with about 2,000 books. It became one of Europe's great research libraries, now holding over 13 million printed items.

events.title: Wilhelm Röntgen discovers X-rays
events.description: Experimenting with a cathode-ray tube in Würzburg, Wilhelm Röntgen noticed a glowing screen across the room and identified a new penetrating radiation. X-rays transformed medicine and won him the first Nobel Prize in Physics.
events.html: Experimenting with a cathode-ray tube in Würzburg, Wilhelm Röntgen noticed a glowing screen across the room and identified a new penetrating radiation. X-rays transformed medicine and won him the first Nobel Prize in Physics.

events.title: Hitler launches the Beer Hall Putsch in Munich
events.description: Adolf Hitler burst into a Munich beer hall and proclaimed a national revolution. The coup collapsed under police fire the next day; Hitler served nine months of a five-year sentence, writing Mein Kampf.

events.title: Franklin D. Roosevelt is elected president
events.description: In the depths of the Great Depression, Franklin Roosevelt defeated Herbert Hoover in a landslide. His New Deal reshaped American government, and he was elected a record four times.
